name: Hadal-Arete
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a nearby asteroid belt, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
